T: Safe to go back to the buffet.
D: Amity Island's police chief is sure another shark is out there, and nobody wants to hear it.
P: Serve the snacks when the teenagers set sail.
S: Chicken salad with avocado and cos in soft rolls, wrapped for the boat
Roast chicken torn up and mixed with lemon mayo, piled into soft rolls with sliced avocado and crisp cos, wrapped tight in paper for the boat.
Buttermilk soaked calamari in a cornmeal crust, with tartare and lemon

Clam meat or calamari soaked in buttermilk, dredged in cornmeal and flour, fried at 185C for 90 seconds, tartare and lemon. Cut 500g calamari into strips and soak in 200ml buttermilk. Dredge in 100g cornmeal and 50g flour and fry at 185C for 90 seconds. Serve with tartare and lemon wedges.
Shark fin chips with prawn ceviche
the fin behind the water skier

Tortillas cut into fin shapes and baked crisp, with a lime-cured prawn ceviche of tomato, red onion, chilli, avocado and coriander to scoop. Cut 8 corn tortillas into triangles, brush with oil, salt and bake at 190C for 10 minutes until crisp. Dice 400g raw peeled prawns and cover with the juice of 5 limes for 20 minutes until opaque. Drain off half the juice and fold in 2 diced tomatoes, half a finely diced red onion, 1 chopped red chilli, 1 diced avocado and a handful of coriander. Season with salt and serve cold with the chips standing up like fins.
M: Clams, prawns, smoked sausage, corn and potatoes steamed in one pot

Clams, prawns, new potatoes and corn steamed in a big pot with white wine, garlic, butter and smoked sausage, tipped onto the table. Boil 600g new potatoes for 10 minutes in a big pot. Add 4 halved corn cobs, 200g sliced smoked sausage, 60g butter and a splash of water, then 1kg clams and 500g prawns. Cover and steam 8 minutes. Tip it all onto the table.
the chief who just wants a quiet summer

Thick chargrilled beef patties with melted cheddar, grilled onions, beefsteak tomato, lettuce, pickles and smoky barbecue mayo in toasted sesame buns. Season 800g beef mince with salt and pepper and shape 4 thick patties with a dimple in the middle. Cook 2 sliced onions slowly in butter for 15 minutes until golden. Grill the patties over high heat for 4 minutes a side, adding a slice of cheddar for the last minute. Mix 4 tbsp mayonnaise with 2 tbsp barbecue sauce. Toast 4 sesame buns and stack with lettuce, tomato, patty, onions, pickles and the mayo.
W: Blueberries under a soft biscuit topping, served with vanilla ice cream
Blueberries with sugar and lemon under a buttery biscuit topping, baked at 190C for 40 minutes. Vanilla ice cream.
K: Golden rum, pineapple, orange and lime juice with grenadine, over ice

Golden rum, pineapple, orange and lime with a splash of grenadine and a grate of nutmeg, mixed by the jug and poured over plenty of ice. Stir 240ml golden rum, 400ml pineapple juice, 200ml orange juice, 80ml lime juice and 40ml grenadine in a large jug. Chill for an hour. Fill 4 tall glasses with ice, pour in the punch and finish each with a little grated nutmeg, a pineapple wedge and a cherry. Make a second jug without the rum and with soda water for the younger crew.
